description: VoltAgent agent run with one tool call inside a conversation, traced by VoltAgent's default observability.
notes: The agent is weather-agent with one tool, get_weather, on openai.chat('gpt-4o-mini') at the mock. setup() registers the harness's global tracer provider, which VoltAgent's default observability uses. generateText runs with userId user-1 and conversationId conv-1, so the agent's memory writes add memory spans: span_names keeps the three spans of the run (the root agent span, llm:generateText and tool.execution:get_weather). The root span has no span.type and entity.type agent; the llm span carries llm.* keys and only the last step's usage (131 and 12); the tool span carries the plain input and output. operation.id, voltagent.operation_id and agent.messages.ui are random per run and listed as volatile. No telemetry leaves the process: the mock is the only host.
